description: This file defines an abstract interface for lesson-related services and a mock implementation that loads lessons from a local JSON asset. It includes methods to fetch all lessons and retrieve a lesson by ID, with specific focus on local asset loading in the mock class.

classes.name: LessonService
classes.description: Abstract interface defining methods for fetching lessons and retrieving a lesson by ID.

classes.name: MockLessonService
classes.description: A mock implementation of LessonService that loads lesson data from a local JSON asset.

methods.name: fetchLessons
methods.description: Fetches a list of lessons, currently from a local JSON asset.

methods.name: getLessonById
methods.description: Retrieves a lesson by its ID from the list of lessons.
